newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X resumes trading, down slightly.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X resumes trading, down slightly.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd resumed trading on Thursday, down slightly after being halted since the close on Tuesday at the company's request.
Trading in Bre-X opened at 20, down from 20.65 at Tuesday's close.

Bre-X asked the Toronto Stock Exchange to halt trading in its shares on Wednesday morning after senior mining officials in Indonesia told Reuters they canceled Bre-X's application for a vital contract of work. Bre-X needs the CoW to go ahead with development of its huge Busang gold deposit in Indonesia.
